system.name: EcoServe
system.one_liner: an LLM-serving system that hierarchically schedules requests across overall, macro-instance, and instance levels using temporal disaggregation and rolling activation

components.name: Overall Scheduler
components.role: assigns requests to macro-instances based on their capabilities

components.name: Instance Handler
components.role: connects the overall scheduler to the instances within a macro-instance

components.name: Macro Instance
components.role: the basic scheduling unit composed of multiple collaborating instances

components.name: Instance
components.role: a single serving unit within a macro-instance

components.name: Macro-Instance Scheduler
components.role: coordinates multiple instances by aggregating execution state and dispatching requests per profiling results and SLOs

components.name: Status queues
components.role: per-instance decode progress and memory usage reported up to the macro-instance scheduler

components.name: Adaptive Scheduling Algorithm
components.role: coordinates instance- and macro-instance schedulers in a master-worker pattern using TTFT/TPOT SLOs and profiling results

components.name: Instance Scheduler
components.role: manages execution within a single instance, including prefill-decode coordination and device orchestration

components.name: Rolling Activation
components.role: staggers instances' prefill phases in a cyclic pattern so at least one instance is always available for prefill

components.name: Temporal Disaggregation
components.role: disaggregates prefill and decode along the time dimension within a single instance

components.name: Mitosis Scaling Approach
components.role: adds or removes instance schedulers at the instance level for fine-grained capacity adjustment

flows.what: requests assigned via the Instance Handler based on macro-instance capabilities
status queues: decode progress and memory usage
dispatch decisions guided by TTFT/TPOT SLOs and profiling results
adds or removes an instance scheduler for capacity adjustment

content.key_idea: EcoServe schedules through three hierarchical levels (overall, macro-instance, instance) so that instances within a macro-instance time-multiplex prefill and decode while rolling activation staggers their prefill phases to keep one always available, and mitosis scaling elastically adds or removes instances.
content.reading_order: Top: Requests enter the Overall Scheduler and fan out to Macro Instances of collaborating Instances. Below, a zoomed-in box details one macro-instance's Macro-Instance Scheduler coordinating several Instance Schedulers, each drawn as a colored prefill/decode timeline read left to right.

evidence: The system adopts a hierarchical architecture with three levels of scheduling
instances enter the prefill phase in a cyclic pattern
The mitosis scaling approach enables capacity adjustments at the instance level rather than the coarser macro-instance level

summary: EcoServe follows a partially disaggregated (PaDG) strategy for cost-effective LLM serving. This figure shows its three-level hierarchical scheduling: an Overall Scheduler assigns incoming requests to Macro Instances, each a basic unit of several collaborating Instances. The lower, zoomed-in box details one macro-instance's internals: a Macro-Instance Scheduler exchanges status queues (decode progress, memory usage) and SLO/profiling information with several Instance Schedulers, each rendered as a colored timeline alternating Decode (blue) and Prefill (green) blocks. Temporal disaggregation lets each instance run both phases over time instead of simultaneously; rolling activation staggers instances' prefill windows so a new request can always be admitted immediately; and the mitosis scaling approach adds or removes instance schedulers, shown as a dashed fourth row, for fine-grained capacity adjustment.
summary_zh: 图示EcoServe三级调度：总调度器把请求分给多实例组成的宏实例；下方放大宏实例内部，调度器间交换状态与SLO信息，各实例按时间轮流做解码/预填充，并靠滚动激活与弹性伸缩动态增减实例。
